question: It is now 12:00:00 midnight, as read on a 12-hour digital clock. In 122 hours, 39 minutes and 44 seconds the time will be $A:B:C$. What is the value of $A + B + C$?
solution:
The clock display repeats every 12 hours. Since \(122=10\cdot12+2\), adding 122 hours to midnight gives the same display as adding 2 hours, namely 2:00:00. Adding 39 minutes and 44 seconds gives 2:39:44, so \(A+B+C=2+39+44=85\).
Final answer: 85
